packageRules.description: VanillaBP and the adapters follow the framework, not Renovate: their versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up.

Camunda 7.24 is the final feature release and the community edition ended with it, so this adapter pins 7.24.x and needs no release lines. Anything above 7.24 could only come from an enterprise environment release, which is a deliberate step rather than an upkeep PR.
